freshness.1.title: status claims
freshness.1.evidence: F-01 run 1 (FIRST-RUN, base 2a699eb7): 10 findings, 10 TP / 0 FP = 0.0%, 3 samples independently re-read at the API. DS-2 run 2 (base eabb0011): the same 10 findings, ALL independently re-verified by the DS-2 lane — the 7 distinct PRs re-read at the API (3142/3140/3132 closed+merged; 2127/1994/2088/2105 closed, merged_at null). Two consecutive triaged runs at 0.0% FP, cumulative n=20 >= 10: the promotion rule is satisfied. The pre-fix extractor run (37.5% FP on this check) is recorded in FIRST-RUN and is why the rule exists; the guard stays armed — a future run triaged >30% FP demotes this class for that run.
freshness.1.since: DS-2 (promoted 2026-10-19 on runs 1+2 evidence; FAIL inside F-01 since v1)
freshness.1.trigger: Demotion: any triaged run with FP rate > 30% demotes for that run automatically (sweep FP guard); a second such run is a Docs Steward review of the class's blocking status.

freshness.2.title: named paths
freshness.2.evidence: F-01 run 1: 3 findings, 3 TP / 0 FP = 0.0%, but n=3 — below the volume the promotion rule needs. Deterministic existence check at its core; the FP risk is grammar (forward references), which the dated-exception mechanism absorbs. DS-2 run 2 (base eabb0011): the same 3 findings, paths verified absent from the tree by direct stat — 3 TP / 0 FP. Cumulative triaged n=6 across two consecutive clean runs: still below the rule's n >= 10, so the class stays advisory — the rule working as designed, not an oversight.
freshness.2.trigger: Cumulative triaged n >= 10 across consecutive runs at FP <= 30%.

freshness.3.evidence: F-01 run 1: 2 findings on a trailing sample of 10 merged PRs, 2 TP / 0 FP. freshness.3.trigger: Blocking in gate mode when gate mode is adopted by the landing seat (documented pending; the repo-CI form waits for the workflow-scope grant).

registry.schema-errors.evidence: DS-1 first validation: 0 findings. Deterministic schema check; FP not statistically estimable and not the promotion currency.

registry.unregistered.evidence: Repo corpus: DS-1 found 75 unregistered files, every one a verified cut class (DELETE 9, EVICT 26, MERGE 34, programme merge sources 6), KEEP-GAP 0 — measured FP 0/75. Blocking on the repo corpus now would hold the gate red on known pre-cut state until the cut lands; the ladder carries these findings meanwhile. Workspace corpus: baseline is 0 unregistered sustained (programme S3.5 metric M: unregistered = 0 counts the system's own bypasses) and the join is deterministic, so any workspace finding is a true bypass — promoted to blocking at DS-2.
registry.unregistered.trigger: Repo corpus promotes when the B1-B7 cut lands (post-cut mode: the validator's --strict semantics). Re-evaluate at W-D1 close.

promotion_rule: A statistical check class promotes advisory -> blocking only after 2 consecutive triaged runs with FP rate <= fp_threshold in EACH run and >= 10 triaged findings across the two runs. Deterministic structural classes (registry join, schema, date comparisons) block by design and are not subject to the statistical rule. If a triaged run shows a blocking class's FP rate > fp_threshold, the sweep demotes that class for that run (DEGRADED, exit 2) — the promotion guard. Changing a mode in this file is a Docs Steward act, recorded in the sweep report that evidences it.
